name: Kōhī (จิบกาแฟ) — Thai Banking Income & Expense Tracker
description: Offline-first, privacy-first personal income & expense tracker designed for Thai banking (K PLUS, SCB Easy, Krungthai NEXT, PromptPay) with on-device slip OCR, EMVCo QR parsing, Android Notification Listener, iOS WidgetKit/Shortcuts, and full Flutter/Kotlin/Swift source code export.
